title:
This type represents the configuration and status of alerting in the reliability risk management pipeline.
It defines the conditions under which alerts should be triggered and the details of these alerts.

The `Alerting` type is used to manage when and how alerts are generated based on model predictions,
risk scores, or system behavior. This might involve setting thresholds, configuring alert channels,
or specifying conditions for alerting based on the monitored data.
name: ReliabilityRiskMl.Alerting
